evidence: V(amd)3 was delivered under its own vapor pressure (without bubbling or nitrogen assist) from a 50 cm3 stainless steel cylinder heated to 190 °C. A constant 10 sccm stream of ultra-high purity nitrogen carrier/purge gas, purified with an Entegris Gatekeeper® metal purifier to ensure H2O and O2 levels were <250 ppt, was continuously pumped through the tool.
